description.en: Personal cinema tracker with local watchlist state and movie metadata search.
description.id: Aplikasi pelacak film personal dengan status watchlist lokal dan pencarian metadata film.

long.en: Built a responsive film catalog for organizing watchlists and logging watched movies. Implemented fast client-side filtering, debounced search against TMDB API, and responsive poster grid layouts.
long.id: Membangun katalog film responsif untuk mengatur daftar tontonan dan riwayat film. Mengimplementasikan pencarian ter-debounce dengan API TMDB, filter client-side instan, dan layout poster grid responsif.

description.en: Full-stack library catalog with Supabase auth, real-time loans, and member reviews.
description.id: Katalog perpustakaan full-stack dengan autentikasi Supabase, peminjaman real-time, dan ulasan anggota.

long.en: End-to-end circulation platform featuring role-based access (admin/member), Supabase PostgreSQL backend with Row-Level Security, real-time book loan tracking, and interactive community reviews.
long.id: Platform sirkulasi buku end-to-end dengan kontrol akses berbasis peran (admin/anggota), backend PostgreSQL Supabase dengan Row-Level Security, pelacakan peminjaman buku real-time, dan ulasan interaktif.

description.en: Audio streaming app featuring playlist management, track uploads, and Howler.js playback.
description.id: Aplikasi streaming audio dengan manajemen playlist, upload trek, dan playback audio Howler.js.

long.en: Full-featured audio platform utilizing Howler.js for seamless playback, timeline scrubbing, and persistent audio state across page transitions managed via Zustand. Backed by Supabase storage for track uploads.
long.id: Platform streaming audio interaktif menggunakan Howler.js untuk playback audio mulus, seekbar scrubbing, dan state audio persisten di seluruh navigasi halaman dengan Zustand, didukung penyimpanan Supabase.
